module_summary: PS/2-style 3-byte packet framer: a 4-state FSM syncs on in[3] to count bytes while a 24-bit shift register captures them, output when DONE.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Tracks byte position BYTE1/BYTE2/BYTE3/DONE of the 3-byte packet.

anchors.name: out_bytes_r
anchors.why: 24-bit shift register capturing the last three input bytes.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Input byte stream shifted into out_bytes_r.

anchors.name: out_bytes
anchors.why: Packet output driven from out_bytes_r when done.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse in DONE state qualifying out_bytes packet data.

anchors.name: in3
anchors.why: Sync bit in[3] marking first packet byte; steers FSM transitions.

groups.name: packet_fsm
groups.description: Byte-position FSM synced by in[3], asserting done after third byte.

groups.name: byte_shift
groups.description: Shift register collecting three bytes, gated to output on done.
